visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of a massive, elongated halisaur (up to 8-9 meters).
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: Horizontal backlighting to stretch the silhouette across the frame.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: Exaggeratedly long, slender jaws. The silhouette should show the 'jagged' profile of numerous small, close-set teeth along the jawline.

pose: Jaws slightly agape in a lateral profile to highlight the extreme length of the dentary and the 'many-toothed' (Pluridens) morphology that distinguishes it from its smaller cousins.
negative_constraints: Maintain a sharp, clean silhouette despite the small tooth detail; no 'fuzzy' jawlines.
